basic_info.description: Welcome to 2018 modern energy-independent home that checks every box for contemporary urban living: spaciousness, privacy, and practical design. Built with meticulous craftsmanship this residence has been lovingly cared for and upgraded with the full suite of smart home technology. The open floor plan is flooded with natural light and features indoor and outdoor entertaining spaces. Gleaming oak hardwood floors throughout all levels add natural warmth to this home.  On the lower level a hallway leads to three bedrooms, two with direct access to a sunny, drought-resistant backyard.   The second floor boasts a dining room with skyline views and a professionally equipped kitchen with Bosch appliances and a Bertazzoni range. Attached is a sizeable family room anchored by a striking Montigo fireplace - perfect to gather around.  Tucked away on the third level is the primary suite offering a quiet sanctuary for the city dweller with a spa-like en-suite bathroom with dual shower heads, a rain shower. The floor is completed with another en-suite bedroom (currently used as an office) with an attached balcony.   Smart features include Nest thermostat, TONAL gym, Sonos built-in speakers, and voice activated lights.  Easy access to freeway and BART make it a commuter paradise.
